|game_text=Deploy on table. At non-[Episode I] sites, immunity to attrition of [Coruscant] Jedi is limited to < 5. Your gametext on [Coruscant] systems is canceled. During your control phase, may say “Coruscant?” and lose 1 Force to place a just-resolved Interrupt in owner's Lost Pile. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Where_Are_You_Taking_Them.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 15 December 2010); [[Where Are You Taking Them? (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Where Are You Taking Them? (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Where Are You Taking Them? (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet (official text as of 15 December 2010): “Deploy on table. At non-[Episode I] sites, immunity to attrition of [Coruscant] Jedi is limited to < 5. Your gametext on [Coruscant] systems is canceled. During your control phase, may say “Coruscant?” and lose 1 Force to place a just-resolved Interrupt in owner's Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 December 2010"), page 2, slip 7 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Where Are You Taking Them? (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=33, page 33. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=33 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Where Are You Taking Them? (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “gametext” to “game text”, “just-resolved” to “just-played” and “owner's” to “owners”: “Deploy on table. At non-[Episode I] sites, immunity to attrition of [Coruscant] Jedi is limited to < 5. Your game text on [Coruscant] systems is canceled. During your control phase, may say 'Coruscant?' and lose 1 Force to place a just-played Interrupt in owners Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1272_7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Where Are You Taking Them? (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-whereareyoutakingthem-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. At non-[Episode I] sites, immunity to attrition of [Coruscant] Jedi is limited to < 5. Your gametext on [Coruscant] systems is canceled. During your control phase, may say “Coruscant?” and lose 1 Force to place a just-resolved Interrupt in owner's Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Where Are You Taking Them? (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 33)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. At non-[Episode I] sites, immunity to attrition of [Coruscant] Jedi is limited to < 5. Your gametext on [Coruscant] systems is canceled. During your control phase, may say “Coruscant?” and lose 1 Force to place a just-resolved Interrupt in owner's Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1272-7-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
